github.description: Issues, pull requests, and repository metadata. Read-only by default; write scopes must be approved per task (docs/agents/permissions.md).

filesystem.description: Repository-scoped file access only. Never widen the path beyond the repository root.

fetch.description: Read documentation. Egress is restricted to hosts allowed by the task brief.

_policy.credentials: No literal secrets. Values use ${ENV_VAR} interpolation and are injected at runtime.
_policy.least_privilege: Prefer read-only tools; request the narrowest write scope needed for the current task.
approval_required_for: any server that can execute shell commands
